associated_projects_response_note: GMrepo v3 may return this endpoint as concatenated Python-dict text; the acquisition parser safely converts those records to dictionaries.
notes: Run records are not automatically independent biological samples.
Biological sample/individual deduplication must occur before model splitting.
Failed/missing QC records must be audited before final cohort construction.
Raw FASTQ/SRA data are intentionally not downloaded by this script.
